headline: Sheger Honey PLC scored 73/100 (Rank 9) on investment readiness, impacted by a missing organogram and priority area count defects.
whyThisRank: Sheger Honey PLC ranks 9th with 73 points on the investment-readiness track, tied on score with Abyssinia Metalworks PLC (Rank 8). It places lower due to unaddressed application defects, including a missing organogram and an incomplete priority area count.
justification: Sheger Honey PLC is fully eligible as a privately owned company with 8 years of operational history. Assessed under the investment-readiness track due to machinery equipment requests, the applicant earned full marks for green sector classification (10/10), international market reach (5/5), headcount (5/5), and female ownership (5/5). However, scoring was pulled down by youth employment levels at 25.8% (2/5) and management capacity (3/5), though job creation plans added 15 points for 21 prospective positions. Application processing noted two formal defects: selecting only two expected result priority areas instead of the required three, and failing to attach the mandatory organogram file.
strengths: Full points achieved for green sector / social and environmental impact (10/10)
Maximum points scored for international/export market reach (5/5) and existing headcount (5/5)
Strong gender participation with 40% female ownership (5/5) and 41.9% female staff (4/5)
Solid job creation potential totaling 21 new positions (15/25)
watchouts: Required organizational structure file (organogram) was not attached
Selected only 2 priority areas under Section 2.4 instead of the required 3
Lower youth employment share at 25.8% (2/5 points)
